notes.title: Update 5 - ORIGIN is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/95f4fb13f25c38ba435b2b6f46c69dca77779d2b.png[/img]


Hey everyone!
With the class update we wanted to bring back switchable abilities, but first and foremost add quality and polish to the classes and do some needed changes and reworks based on your feedback.

Keep in mind that the classes are not and not supposed to be perfect and final, the bulk work is done but there will be further refinements over time based on your feedback. Overall the classes are much more engaging, refined and have more identity and replay value. For the future we have Rogue, Assassin and Engineer also in the works but with 12 classes you'll have a lot to play right now.


[h1][b]U5 Key Features:[/b][/h1]
[h3]- Overhaul of [b]12 classes[/b], tons of huge changes!
- New [b]Switchable ability slots[/b]
- New [b]Eliminator [/b]class
- New [b]Heavy Gunner[/b]
- New [b]Rocketeer[/b]
- New [b]Sniper[/b]
- Many [b]level & graphical[/b] improvements
- New [b]Stat upgrades[/b]
- New [b]Items & Weapons[/b]
- Item & Attachment improvements
- Improved loot progression (Part 1)
- Huge under-the-hood & [b]UniversEdit [/b]improvements
- Tons of fixes and[b] improved audio[/b]
- [b]Many [/b]other improvements[/h3] 


[i]Known issues:
- Sometimes kill and hit audio goes missing
- (!) Avoid reloading or switching weapons at level changes/teleporter
- Sometimes icons display wrong
- Looking into fixes ASAP[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/14736e1efdb9f8dc0d218687bcdb13938bf01e91.png[/img]



[h3][b]NEW Class - Eliminator[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/91156c96540556eb80f72792c8b41bb284f2817e.png[/img]

The Eliminator is a new [b]bounty hunting class[/b] with dual wielded handguns and [b]powerful gadgets.[/b]
He does [b]not want to get caught[/b] and can circles his victims with his distracting infiltration ability, while going for weakpoint kills to get credits rewards.

His switchable abilities offer powerful gadgets, like the dangerous [b]room clearing eliminator drone,[/b] or the [b]distractor laser cluster drones[/b]. He can also place a [b]seth-up laser sentry turret[/b] in classic professional hitman fashion. He is not easy to play but offers some nice rewards. 


[h3][b]NEW Class - Sniper[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/a8cd6b537cfed480a6b7bd7fe5f2f46ebab8dd06.png[/img]

The Sniper is finally back! With his [b]target-laser [/b]and focus on [b]weakpoint hits[/b], he is not to be toyed with. He now deals area damage on headshots and has quite some new gadgets to try.
His LS-30 is a powerful starter weapon and looks equally bad-ass. He also has different mobility choices. More tweaks to sniper will arrive based on community feedback!



[h3][b]NEW Class - Heavy Gunner[/b][/h3]
The [b]Heavy gunner [/b]is back with a force!
Dishing out heavy sustained firepower and starting with a cylindrical magazine LMG,
the Heavy gunner is a force to be reckoned with! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/814a3fbb59ed379bf0f0144801120925da9ba191.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/2c8eb24fdc4cab66940bc075fac5aaca6a153307.png[/img]

[i]The new Heavy gunner mostly follows the classic S1 Heavy Gunner. Simple but highly effective and with more madness than ever.[/i]




[h3][b]NEW Class - Rocketeer[/b][/h3]
The [b]Rocketeer [/b]has been completely remade and essentially returns the key S1 Demolisher elements but adds some new twists. With[b] Seismic Resonator[/b] you can re-trigger previous explosions for powerful combos (even enemy ones!). [b]Rocket boost[/b] and resonator allows [b]catapulting out of danger[/b] and burning noses of near enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/f0e9c3a8d06402d8384a6bef063e400a35af4ac7.png[/img]

[i]The Rocketeer has heavy AOE damage potential but is not as durable as other Grenadier classes. Imagine a trick-jumping sniper with explosive launchers. More tuning is to come.[/i]




[h2][b]HUGE TOTAL CLASS OVERHAUL![/b][/h2]

- [b]Essentially everything is new![/b]
- All classes got a ton of improvements and changes
- Varied [b]new starter weapons[/b] have been added
- Just log in and check out everything with [b]fresh eyes![/b]
- You can skip the wall of text and just check it all out ingame.



[h3][b]Total Rework - Riotguard[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/4c8b88e201e66f23bacc891417529df536bcf341.png[/img]

Riotguard got reworked and is now a [b]aggressive shield bashing melee brawler[/b], while the Judge has the more S1 / previous style shield dash and bulwark. The Riotshield can now be toggled on and off, he no longer has energy shields. With low cooldown close range attacks and [b]stagger combos[/b]. Riotguard feels like a brawling game character almost and is much more fun now. Try it out!

[i]Some more Riotguard changes are to be expected, especially the Perks will see work and maybe some more tweaks to the shield mechanic, but this is already a huge upgrade.[/i]



[h3][b]Improved - Guard Judge[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/ec8abe0184b4f27263d2b6579b93654d9ce6de21.png[/img]

Guard Judge has been improved in all areas. His [b]Heavy Shield Dash[/b] with Bulwark up is very powerful, and he can also now [b]handcuff [/b]people by dashing into them without the shield. His Bulwark got reworked into [b]Stabilized Bulwark[/b], enabling a sort of "[b]Pistolero Mode[/b]" where you have virtually no recoil for 3 seconds and can open a fight with well placed accurate shots. He also got greatly improved visual effects making it much more fun to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/f885c2a2ec8009d91d78b2315a2c19c52312037c.png[/img]

[i]Some more things are [b]planned [/b] for Judge for the future, adding a "Performance Review" feature, where police duties are reviewed, and you are up-ranked if you fulfill the acceptable ratio of causalities, property damage and accuracy. A New Judge revolver is also in the works.[/i]



[h3][b]Improved - Disruptor[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/c8c1e0a924c9e51c0e786f0b78b00cdf6d784f8d.png[/img]

[b]Disruptor [/b]recieved quite some improvements. He now has a [b]stunning lightning punch[/b] which can be triggered in melee range. His mobility is now a protective shield, which aids allies and constructs. He can also punch his shock trophy for a [b]powerful combo.[/b]The energy shields got removed to favor a more high stakes playstyle. He really excels in playing with cover and [b]taking aggressively pot shots melee range[/b] with his punch attacks all around sight blockers and cover, but never wants to be caught open field. 

[i]With the lightning cluster, masterkey and the Cryo turret he has quite flexible specialization abiliites- Disruptor has a quite unique playstyle which might be more for acquired tastes but definitely brings something special to the table, like some sort of melee engineer. More work on his perks and tweaks onto the shield ability are planned.[/i]



[h3][b]Improved - Grenadier[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/4cfb049cd58926658b43b563efcf6a44255bfb34.png[/img]

Assault Grenadier got [b]removed [/b]and his features got [b]merged [/b]into the base Grenadier.
Grenadier's kit worked well and mostly saw polish and new perks, improved vfx and more
Grenadier got improved VFX and new perks and should see a noticeable improvement.
Some more work on Grenadier perks is planned as well!



[h3][b]Reworked - Chrono Trooper[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/d0c2c5337a753958aa023961a24fa83b82379366.png[/img]

Chrono Trooper recieved quite some big changes and has much more depth now. Varied [b]timing based benefits[/b] make him all about [b]split second decisions and execution[/b]. He now also starts with a capable [b]fusion SMG[/b]. Chrono charge has varied interactions and his new [b]temporal ammo[/b] perk gives him the boost to distinguish his role as a weapon based soldier / smg ambusher type.

[i]The new "slow motion" ability also further gives him some unique time based power.
Some more tweaks about the details of his combos and perks in general are expected. [/i]



[h3][b]Reworked - Chrono Striker[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/904404fc36c5f79ed8511855ee48ecd67612a21f.png[/img]

Chrono Striker got many improvements and now builds around [b]telefragging,[/b] chaining abilities for [b]powerful combos[/b] and in general has become some sort of mobility-based 'mage' class.
He now owns the freshly upgraded shield dome and has some nice other abilities. 
Striker's hard reset bonus is on the watchlist for future changes.



[h3][b]Improved - Chrono Breacher[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/e55fa4e7a32e769af12d41d5d78226338add4a08.png[/img]

Chrono breacher has seen varied upgrades, mostly varied S1 elements were brought back, but some new twists were added as well. You can now do stagger combos with blink, go with a stimulant or explosive build with the focus perks. Many polishing tweaks have been done. Blink now also grants a powerful "priority take-down" bonus if you teleport into multiple targets and more. Overall we are quite happy with the class, maybe some sounds could be further improved.



[h3][b]Reworked - Anti-Material Recon[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/c306a01437d6253a334b4b63a1f8aac86e56c34e.png[/img]

The Anti-Material recon got some bigger changes. He now has a distinct [b]"take cover" ability,[/b] giving him durability and staying power to out-damage the opposition. [h3][b]Removed - Psy Recon[/b][/h3]
The Psy recon felt too different and it's execution was not great. There are some good elements we want to bring back, such as the psy field, or the shot, but overall we think his kit should rather be in the future assassin or be items. It is still possible to get the Psy recon back, it is just not enabled in the menu by default. Feel free to upgrade and make a mod out of it or just use it for yourself!

How to get it back:
- Open universEdit, (Create a depot if needed) 
- Go to PlayerClassSpecialization on the left
- Copy the Psy Recon
- Give your new copy a new name (Add a 'New' Localization on top)
- Click "Specialization of the Following Class" > Search
- Search the Recon, and confirm
- Save the class
- It now will be back in the menus

[h3][b]Improved Loot Progression / Mid game progression[/b] (Part 1)[/h3]
[i]Now after the classes are much more engaging, we no longer have to compensate by adding a bunch of random upgrades in the early game where they do not belong. We also noticed that the mid-game progression is lacking. We initially made the mistake of putting too much focus on special shops (Gambler etc), while these should only be a rare bonus thing. The reason this was done was because items are not as good as they can be and that deceived into adding more other things to compensate, which was clearly a fallacy.

The plan now after U5 is first to polish up the items to be the sandbox that is at the essence of the game progression and improve the upgrade systems, while taking away focus from special shops.[/i]

Another thing that stood out was that you plateau'd extremely quickly and then after the first boss you were already fully geared and the game became bland and repetitive. This was one thing that we also really hated in S1. Below is a very simplified visual representation, and some details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/2dfd30bf80c0813f6d72dc236f18b7dc40d9c6da.png[/img]



[h3][b]Raritiy drops:[/b][/h3]
- You were getting too many legendaries and epics right [b]at the start[/b], this destroyed the progression
- You now get [b]more blue rarity (common / uncommon) at the start[/b] of the game
- Added an additional rarity scaling, this essentially works like luck and increases rarity of loot
- This will result in you finding more epics and legendaries after the first boss but less before
- Varied [b]weapon rarities have been adjusted[/b]


[h3][b]Chests:[/b][/h3]
- Chests were too many and confusing. There were 6 metal chests for weapons.
- [b]Removed [/b]Intermediate metal police and metal military item & weapon chests
- Chests now: [b]Wood > Metal > Legendary Metal Police / Legendary Metal Military[/b]
- It is now easier to distinguish the different chests and their expected contains
- The Medical chest is now more rare but [b]fully heals[/b]


[h3][b]Shops:[/b][/h3]
- Mid-Map Shops (Gambler, Medical etc) now start spawning [b]after the first Boss[/b]
- We think the class starting kits easily hold their own and we don't need these extras to fill in
- End-Map Shops (Pandoras, Compositor) now start spawning in the third map (Before the boss)
- Ability Upgrade shops now are [b]multi use[/b] (But there will be a overhaul upcoming)


[h3][b]TLDR:[/b][/h3]
Overall these changes are making the early game less overloaded and rarities less random.
You get a more logical loot and power progression throughout the maps.
The game "opens up" after the first boss, where more things come into play, compared to "Im done"
More work on making items and mid-game progression better is coming in thenext update.

We are looking for your feedback here, but the next update will make this all more complete.

notes.title: Dev Update - Lots of infos!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/0777d83c664457019b7ba1d53927cb57ae66fe7a.png[/img]


Hey everyone!

[i]Originally the class update was planned to be a shorter update, supposed to add a good iteration or rework some classes, however after starting on some of the classes, level perks and the new switchable slots, it became apparent how the game transformed. It seemed to be the right thing to go all the way and bring it all to that higher level, so you will see a ton of changes in the test branch and the full update. 

We also switched our content system to stream content (using "adressables") which means packing things in bundles, as opposed to loading everything directly. This was an important step but causes quite some issues at the start. So overall things did not go exactly as planned and we are sorry for the long wait for an update, but a lot of things have happened in the meantime, and we mean a lot. 
So here we go!:[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/852435f8948c9c6803cf99f71547d877b6bee5f5.png[/img]

[h3][b]The Testing Branch is live![/b][/h3]
Try the class update [b]U5 - ORIGIN[/b] and let us know what you think.
Now is the time for your feedback on the revamped classes.
There are a huge amount of changes, but some things aren't fully final yet.
At best just try it out with a fresh set of eyes and let us know what you think!

[quote]You can enable the public test branch by right clicking your [b]steam [/b]library game settings and going to the last tab, and enable the test version in the drop down menu![/quote]


[h3][b]U5 ORIGIN - The Big Class Update[/b][/h3]
Overhauling 12 classes was quite a huge amount of work but it did definitely pay off.
The class update is not supposed to make the classes perfect but give them all a clear foundation and well working core gameplay. We also don't say "specs" anymore, as these are really more like 12 separate classes with some shared elements and body frame at this point. 
Some bullet points for the class update are below. It is expected to come out of testing this week, so last chance for your feedback!


[h3]- New [b]Switchable ability[/b] slots
- Overhaul of 12 classes, tons of huge changes!
- New Eliminator class
- New Heavy Gunner
- New Rocketeer
- New Sniper
- Many level & graphical improvements
- Stat upgrades are back
- Varied attachment balance tweaks and others
- Tons of under the hood & UniversEdit improvements
- Fixes audio system and tons of fixes
- Many other improvements[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/332e88f30bee0060dc49cbb9e189441ab08f8de4.png[/img]

Please write down your class changes wishlist in the poll here:
[i]IN CASE OF STEAM BLOCKING THE LINK - PLEASE COPY PASTE IT MANUALLY TO YOUR BROWSER![/i]
https://forms.gle/zRysjn71xcgCUQwS8




[h2]Other noteworthy things:[/h2]


[h3][b]- Super boosted workflows and tools:[/b][/h3]
Our next level ingame editor [b]UniversEdit [/b]has come a long way since the EA launch and even made big leaps compared to the start of the year, the[b] workflows have improved dramatically[/b] and we also have become [b]way more skilled at using it[/b]. Tons of things have improved under the hood and the power is steadily growing.

As example, we can now use [b]UniversEdit while in the game[/b], so it is possible to make changes while playing, save, and then just respawn the ability or weapon, and it will be updated. There are still some inconveniences and a bit laggy menus but [b]we have achieved real ingame creation of game content![/b]
This is [b]not yet[/b] available for modding, some things need to be sorted out, but in general we probably have a [b]500% increase in iteration times[/b] since new years, and an similar [b]reduction [/b]in bug creation!



[h3][b]- Pushing the boundaries[/b][/h3]
On the updated classes and new abilities, you will see a lot more things which are outside the box as we tried to push boundaries and see what kind of things can be done with the current tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/72d4b2d05b3be5a8fd611046709f68b6a9d57d69.gif[/img]

[b]New things that are in testing or are already achieved:[/b]

- Glaiving attacks, bouncing from target to target
- Charge up attacks
- Directional microwave emitter construct
- Placable gadgets which can be stepped on
- C4 which can be remotely triggered
- Neutrino bomb with a timed fuse
- Punching constructs for combos
- Thunder and warning poles you can stick in the ground
- TOW Missile launcher emplacements which can fire a guided missile Battlefield style
- Weapons jammer, blocking enemy weapons
- Seismic resonator which can retrigger explosion and used for knockback movement
- Rocket boosts with weapons
- Stealth or partial stealth effects
- Drone swarms
- Mind control
- Sticky Bombs which stick to enemies
- Slow Motion effects
- Delayed lock-on missiles
- "Hold" abilities, like targetlaser
And more


[h3][b]- Content / Memory Management[/b][/h3]
We are now using the "Adressables" system from the engine, which is a different way of handling content and [b]bundling them in packages[/b]. The difficulty is that you can't have any object reference any other from another package, else both packages will be loaded, defeating the entire purpose.
This is also an important step as this makes adding more content (and mods!) not increasing ram cost. In some areas this also drives down overall [b]loading times,[/b] as the game will not wait for content to be loaded anymore (that may not be used any time soon).

This system added quite some headaches and delays to the test branch updates but it seems to be mostly sorted out, and ensures that the project is more scaleable. Weeks prior we also had a spring cleaning and removed a ton of unused assets, reducing the game size noticeably as well.
The benefits for you are that [b]RAM usage is now overall a lot lower,[/b] in some areas [b]50%[/b] from before. The game now comfortably sits way below 8GB RAM usage. 
Our project cleanups also reduced the [b]game size by 30%[/b] without losing anything!



[h3][b]- Graphical Improvements[/b][/h3]
Some more graphical improvements have been done in varied areas.
Some of these are not used everywhere yet, but these are all things which strengthen our foundation for the future. Varied points are [b]listed below[/b]:



[h3][b]- Bent Normal Occlusion[/b][/h3]
By using [i]bent normals[/i] to check on the lighting direction, unwanted glowing reflections are reduced, making things looks more realistic. You can see here that the underside of the vehicle does not strangely glow anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/a9f4506ce821951552bba63dabd57ad81fb0098e.png[/img]



[h3][b]- New Focus on ground details[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/e6140e4fb67bd3d2fdb9672446d59cfb71725614.png[/img]

Since most of the visible playing field is ground, we want to add more depth, detail and 3-dimensionality into the ground elements. Some maps already have more of that, but in varied maps there is still a lot of room for improvement. In the screenshot you can see a combination of varied new elements, decals, grills, border trims and more. In general, we all have become more skilled at environment creation and it really shows if you compare newer iteration to our first.



[h3][b]- New Decal shaders[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/9d2b36c50f38b167f55b34fc457dbd3579882e01.png[/img]

Varied new shaders have been made, they are not fully in use yet but are a significant improvement
Wet puddles can now look significantly more detailed, but also new grunge decals now exist with both more variation and way higher detail and resolution. They can be combined and are based on world space. Grunge shader example:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/a5709290dcadad13b7bda1d6dbb50a327111657b.gif[/img]



[h3][b]- Occlusion [/b][/h3]
We also did some more tricks to shadow areas like the pipes in the oilrig area or deep holes better
and also did new occlusion decals and used more of them, which can shadow objects more realistically where they touch the ground.

[h3][b]- Micro Shadows[/b][/h3]
By using the bent normal technique, we also can now use micro shadows, which do enable more detailed occlusion at small details especially.



[h3][b]- Water[/b][/h3]
As the saying goes, [i]if you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself[/i], so we are throwing out things like Unity terrain or plugin water and doing our own implementations. These will be more flexible and have no dependencies or breaking points we can't control. Also we think they will look better in the end. Here is our current new water shader (this has improved in the meantime again):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/0b130bbace70aa8a5701dd9c0a0e6e15cf8758e1.gif[/img]



[h3][b]- Custom Terrain Material[/b][/h3]
The environment team has been developing our new foundation for terrain shaders which are very promising so far and will be the core of future outdoors areas. The terrain shader supports mesh blending, camera based render textures for things like snow trails, varied layers, tesselation and more.

We also worked on mesh blending techniques, which smoothly transistions between the ground and the asset and avoids sharp ugly intersections. Here a preview of the blending and worldspace biome effect (does not represent final terrain quality)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/d868d956d94521c901ef881dfd357f92fdf1e331.gif[/img]



[h3][b]- New Floors[/b][/h3]
2 new floors are in development the moment, one is coming very soon "[b]The Cooling Chambers[/b]", as alternative second floor, while the other is an alternative for the Arctic level, which is more military themed, but you'll see. We are also looking at some potential arena style maps, but this has lower priority right now.

[h3][b]- System Improvements[/b][/h3]
Now that the classes are much more engaging, it becomes glaringly apparent that the mid game progression is not at the level it should be. The class update already does tweak the curve of when things appear but this is only one part of it. 

--[b]Item Quality[/b]
Items at the moment are often quite lackluster.
[b]After [/b]the class update, a focus will be to polish up items and make them into the core game sandbox they should be. Often it is mostly visual polish but sometimes the gameplay is simply not engaging. Playing with some of the new items makes it quite clear what the old items are just not on our new skill level and possibility space. Items are the core of Synthetik progression and due to them being lackluster, we tried compensating with shops and other things but that was a bit of a fallacy. Shops will also be improved.

As example, Power array now has a chargup time, sound, glow, laser targeting, screen fx and a buff, a huge difference from before where it just fired an ion shot. Some items have been upgraded a bit already like Power Array but more is to come.

--[b]Item Synergies[/b]
We want to add an synergy system which links many items, to form a nice interlocking system of varied builds, planning and choices. Some examples which are already implemented:
- [b]Shock net[/b] can electrify the spike strips, making them root enemies
- [b]SAT masterkey[/b] fires incendiary shots when you have hot shot
- [b]Field rations[/b] allows petting the dog for healing and granting a boost
S1 synergy items will likely also return in some form, like [b]missile control[/b] boosting all missile items.

--[b]Item/Ability Upgrades[/b]
We are doing an improvement of the system here as well, which will build upon item categories instead of being completely random and the same for all. The current system is too freestyle and unspecific even though it allows for some broken combinations. More info soon.

--[b]Class Upgrades[/b]
There is also an idea of mid-run class upgrades replacing the focus perks, but we'll see..



[h3][b]- Multiplayer[/b][/h3]
Our fully [b]dedicated server based[/b] Multiplayer is progressing steadily, it is playable for some time but it needs polish polish polish and as many fixes. It is finally the time where the team starts internally doing serious playtests and where we gradually clean up the issues and start balancing and implementing coop specific features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/02646da202b872194018f122bdb5a27a15966ec6.png[/img]

Instead of reviving at the next map upon dying, we are trying out a [b]revive mechanic[/b] where you trade health to revive a player. This is more punishing on the team and less of a negative feedback loop where the dying player keeps getting weaker and then dies more because he has become weaker. 
This should create more tension, be more fair and hopefully avoid making coop significantly easier than single-player.

Our plan for online coop is to have a first public test branch version ready around the Enemy Update.
Right now its most important to fix and polish up the game to a good level and getting multiplayer polished before it's given out. S1 multiplayer very unstable at launch and prone to crashing, we definitely want to avoid this.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/3b6c31a6a97e7af815d8319fefa96b0025379a2c.png[/img]


[h3][b]Brief Roadmap:[/b][/h3]

[b]U5 ORIGIN[/b] "The Big Class Update" 
- Expected this week! Last chance for your class feedback!

[b]U6 HEAT [/b]
- Short in-between Update
- Full New "Cooling Chambers" Environment
- Environment Styles (spoiler in the thumbnail)
- Item & Upgrade System improvements
- ?

[b]U7 LEGION[/b] "The Big Enemy Update"
- More info in a near future dev blog!
- First Multiplayer testing on test branch around that time


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/4b162fe208e94735bba2989c29616208c22d4ae8.png[/img]


[b]Thats all for today![/b] After the class update has gone live, the enemy update will follow but we keep the enemy update talk for later.

Don't forget the class poll, we really act on your feedback so don't waste the opportunity!

https://forms.gle/zRysjn71xcgCUQwS8

[i]! In case of steam blocking the link - please copy it manually into your browser !![/i]

See you on the field, Androids!
- Team FFG

[h2]New [b]HD Weapon Images[/b][/h2]
- All S2 weapon images in the menu use new HD versions!


[h2]120 New [b]Weapon Technology Perks[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/d7df80424f375d4598819a9a641862240721c77a.png[/img]

- Weapon perks system has been [b]completely overhauled and extremely expanded![/b]
- How it works: Weapons generally have 3 perk slots
- In most cases, [b]2[/b] of these are filled with a [b]random Tech Perk[/b] based on the weapon's technology
- Each [b]technology [/b]has a [b]different pool of perks[/b]. A Laser weapon will get laser perks.
- Perks are unlocked by [b]dealing damage[/b] as before
- Earlier levels are now unlocked faster

[quote]Now when you pick up a weapon, you can compare and make informed considerations about which weapons to go for. You will notice that picking and inspecting a weapon will have a very new feeling and depth to it.[/quote]

[h2]New [b]Conversions[/b][/h2]
- Technologies can also have [b]rare 'conversion'[/b] perks
- These can add an [b]additional twist [/b]to the gun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/556d71acc6c88e59a2a34481e9ddb711e35a4122.png[/img]



[h2]New [b]Unique Weapon Perks[/b][/h2]
- All non starter weapons now have [b]at least one unique weapon perk[/b]
- In the above example, the rifled third barrel is a Honorary dominator unique perk
- Unique perks are always on the weapon and always at the [b]same slot[/b]
- In some cases they are unlocked early, in most they are unlocked as [b]third option[/b].

[quote]The unique weapon perks often come at the end of the leveling, so you can 'discover' a weapon by fully committing to it. You'll see something new that you wouldn't otherwise by just casually picking up the gun and then putting it away again. For weapons where it is key to the identity, the perks is usually at the first levelup.[/quote]



[h2]New [b]Weapon Variants[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/712f74768ed5dcd7751bcad4d370f2f1da5e36a7.png[/img]
- [b]15 New weapon variants[/b] have been added
- Weapon variants now have their[b] new floppy disc images[/b]
- The floppy discs represent the user manual
- Varied existing variants have been reworked





[h2]Huge [b]Attachment Update[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/73b2d0c5a7f453132d2745bbc80ac71f2967c146.gif[/img]

- [b]Tons of attachments[/b] have been added, for [b]over 80 total![/b]
- Most existing attachments have been [b]reworked or improved[/b]
- [b]Let us know[/b] which attachments you do and do not like and which should be changed.
- Attachment costs have been [b]reduced [/b]slightly, the last attachment costs more
- Weapon Rarity also affects the cost less than before
- Attachments now [b]rarely use uncommon or epic rarities[/b] for consistency
- [b]Legendary and Divine[/b] attachments have been added




[h2]New [b]Switchable Ammo Types[/b][/h2]
- Weapons can also now have multiple [b]ammo types[/b]
- All ammo types have [b]tooltips[/b]
- You can get a new type either through the [b]'Ammo Switch' attachment[/b], or from the [b]Tinkerer shop[/b]
- Ammo types can be [b]switched[/b] in the menu or while playing
- Each weapon type has [b]at least one alternative type[/b], the common types have [b]multiple[/b]
- Some ammo types can offer drastical changes, most offer a small twist in effectiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/a5b86e0c2acad85125e4dd508f3a433e0d1f39e4.png[/img]

[quote]Ammo types are intended as a slightly uncommon element of which you keep discovering types over time. They are not essential to play, but offer a nice layer of mystery, discovery and depth.[/quote]


[h2]Other [b]Weapon changes[/b][/h2]
- Weapon [b]experience required has been reduced[/b] especially for the first level
- Pistols can now gain [b]variants [/b]through perks
- Explosions can now [b]critically strike[/b] with critical strike chance
- You can now [b]eject [/b]the weapon when the spare ammo[b] is empty[/b]
- Tons of fixes regarding action saving, save and load, weapon swapping and level changes
- Many weapons have been tweaked

[h2]New [b]Legendary & Divine[/b] Weapon Variants, Attachments[/h2]
- Weapons can also now have Ultra and Divine variants
- These are super rare and heavily boost stats!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/83c04c66fe107ddc5b8b51b5098ce3cfbf80c6d3.png[/img]

[h2]New [b]Camera[/b][/h2]
- The camera is now a bit more zoomed out
- The camera allows scrolling out further outwards
- The camera has a more shallow FOV, meaning it has less perspective
- This makes the screen estate much more consistent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/accf5982f55cde3563dc4fe48c94a432ad84efd5.png[/img]


[h2]Improved [b]Player Collisions[/b][/h2]
- It should now be harder to get stuck or get blocked on ramps

[h2]Improved [b]Maps and Game Length[/b][/h2]
- The game was stretched out way too long, we trimmed varied maps
- Many map improvements have been done

[h2]Increased [b]Ranges[/b][/h2]
- Ammo ranges have been [b]increased around 20%[/b]
- Keep in mind that the zoom and camera panning distance has also increased.

[quote]In General ranges are increased but shorter range weapons will still not be able to shoot offscreen although more range upgrades now exist also. Long range weapons can shoot around screen border. Since enemies are tied to these ranges, we are touching these very slowly at a time[/quote]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/549dbfcfec5089604352b02d4541a06e05dbb25d.png[/img]


[h2]New [b]Menu Design[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/3cfd3720693734a16e382283695c06d5eb37414d.png[/img]

- Still work in progress, but most menus have gotten a visual upgrade
- Varied elements also have gotten extra animations
- This was done for most menus and will be further improved over time


[h2]Many [b]UI improvements across the board[/b][/h2]
- Most of the elements in the game have been touched, at best check it out for yourself!
- Improved [b]weapon levelup, item and weapon pickup popups[/b]
- Improved the [b]enemy healthbars[/b] to show ranks better and be more readable
- More work needs to be done but this is an important step.


[h2]Improved [b]Feedback[/b][/h2]
- Some parts of the UI have gotten [b]new animations[/b], especially the weapon frame
- Enemy [b]hitflash [/b]has been made snappier
- Enemy healthbar now [b]shakes [/b]on hits for better feedback
- New systems have been setup for [b]better feedback[/b] on actions:
-- New [b]muzzle glow[/b] effects
-- New [b]laser pointer[/b] effects
-- New [b]character particle[/b] effects
- New [b]sound system[/b] for [b]object collision[/b]s (work in progress)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/01d9c96442dfc46030f95668372585438f33945b.gif[/img]



[h2]New [b]Status Effects[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/7824140a460675b7eb60a9c7dee8b16af5fbbeff.png[/img]

- You will start seeing more status effects with proper sounds, VFX and buff icons
- This is an important step for the [b]core gameplay ruleset[/b] but more work will be done there

[h2]New [b]Ground Loot UI[/b][/h2]
- You can now see items and weapons with icon and name on the ground

[h2]New [b]Credits menu[/b][/h2]
- You can now see the credits in the Universe Tab menu


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/f102d7cac2f14bf7dd8d293fd3b9f35dc24051e0.png[/img]

[h2]New [b]Tinkerer Shop Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/d427c2ce6f2e16775820e85ff669a68c2c0c3769.png[/img]
[b]- Weapon Mastercraft
- Ammo Fitting
- Upgrade Kit
- Divine Ammunition Total conversion
- Path of the Weaponsmith[/b]

[h2][b]Shop Tweaks[/b][/h2]
Weapon shop costs:
- Epic: [b]1500 > 1200[/b]
- Legendary: [b]2500 > 2000[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/93ef0ff113177cbd5dde1e5952a2e64a5e972f66.png[/img]

[h2][b]Enemy Tweaks[/b][/h2]
- We focus more on enemies in the next 2 coming updates
- (Rank bonuses are added on top of each other)
- Rank 1 enemies health unchanged from +30% +500
- Rank 2 enemies health from +125%+500 to +30%+1000
- Rank 3 enemies health from +300%+500 to +150%
- Rank 3 enemies max shield from 2000 to 4000
- Rank 2 and 3 enemy magsize, firerate scaling reduced 

- Escalation 3 enemy damage +10%
- Changed enemy spawning to be more specific to floors
- This means[b] less low level enemies spawn[/b] in the later levels
- Shotgunners movement [b]speed reduced [/b](also their Rank ones are much weaker)
- Riotshield has reduced health
- Riotshield speed reduced
- Remade arena master taser to [b]shoot straight[/b] instead of auto lock-on
- Increased environment prop armor values to increase [b]bounce[/b] chances
- Alarm wheel does not cancel the spawn if sight is interrupted


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/5b5af43d1676a76678aeec1551164370ed1234a1.png[/img]

[h2]New [b]Sharper Image[/b][/h2]
- Increased[b] sharpness of the entire game[/b] visuals noticeably!
- Increased[b] sharpness of TAA[/b] noticeably

[h2]New [b]Color Grading[/b][/h2]
- Added subtle[b] color grading[/b] for better colors and contrast

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/3c7dc77d1c43ccd3cfc6bf017f8b62adbe2454b8.gif[/img]


[h2]New [b]'Screenshot' Setting[/b][/h2]
- Added expensive setting for post processing, which has [b]Screen Space Global Illumination[/b]
- Inefficient and [b]not recommended for gameplay[/b] for most people but looks good
- Adds more realistic fake ray tracing like shadowing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/d54c72199d1a15df761a722634e51d735975c7bc.gif[/img]


[h2]New [b]HBAO[/b][/h2]
- Ultra and Screenshot setting have Horizon Based Ambient Occlusion now enabled
- Improves shadowing and definition of assets in the environment

[h2]New [b]Shadow Cascade Quality[/b][/h2]
- You can now have [b]noticeably sharper shadows[/b] by using the shadow cascades on 'Normal'
- The previous setting is equivalent to 'Low'
- Make sure to set it [b]back to low [/b]if you don't want a small decrease in performance

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/dc6b539d1b4fb2e44f7ef1f63af3dff6589e8651.gif[/img]


[h2]New [b]Enemy Glow & Blob shadows[/b][/h2]
- Enemies/Player now have a [b]glow effect[/b] similar to S1, making them easier to see in the environment
- Enemies/Player now use [b]blob/drop shadows[/b], making them [b]more grounded[/b] in the environment

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/c878d789b7d2a69620d04d505a2fd15725afbabc.gif[/img]


[h2]More [b]Performance Improvements[/b][/h2]
- More improvements have been done, especially [b]Low settings[/b] have been trimmed [b]GPU [/b]wise
- Main menu performance has been improved

[h2]Better [b]Loading Times[/b][/h2]
- Loading times have been [b]reduced by around 30%[/b]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/0fffaf9f5185f3b1835cacabcf8806d9cf7be2ea.png[/img]

[h2]New [b]Entity Spawning[/b][/h2]
- You can now finally also spawn gameentities with a button in the F3 menu

[h2]New [b]Conditions[/b][/h2]
- Check for weapon category (SMG, LMG, Faction ..)
- Check for weapon technology type
- Check for current ammo of magazine (last shot..)
- Check for current ammo of magazine percentage
- Allow weapon selling

[h2]New [b]Results / Effects[/b][/h2]
- Replace ammo type
- Add ammo type
- Change weapon rarity, change actionrarity
- Add attachment to character/weapon (muzzle glow, laser etc)
- Added option for random weapon perks and tech based perks in weapon config

[h2]New [b]Stats[/b][/h2]
- Pellet count
- Damage Falloff Distance

[h2]New [b]Ammo Stats[/b][/h2]
- Alert range
- Backside hits
- Ammo gained

[h2]New [b]Projectile Editor[/b][/h2]
- You can now create custom Projectiles
- Homing, Curving, Grenade, Cursor target etc

[h2]Config [b]Cleanups[/b][/h2]
- Weapon configuration is much easier to navigate
- Game Entity is much simpler to navigate and understand
- Fixed shoot ammo only shooting one projectile from ammo and not using range properties
- Status effects, Ammo and Explosions had configs cleaned up and are ready to be used!

[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]
- For some people the depot dosnt update changes until restart
- Editor info tooltips are often not displaying as they should


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/83c04c66fe107ddc5b8b51b5098ce3cfbf80c6d3.png[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] 
- We were testing the new environment on Test branch but feel its not ready yet for this update


[h2]General [b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]
- Pickups sometimes lack sounds
- Sometimes you can switch ammo types without ejection
- In some hotkey constellations, the display shows a black icon
- The attachment menu is still showing over the weapon stats
- Burst weapons gain too much heat

[h2][b]Bugs[/b][/h2]
- This patch has been longer on Test branch than all others and a ton of things have been fixed, overall this should be the best state yet, but that does not mean there are not a good bunch of new bugs which slipped through. Remember to post in the respective channels!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/734611886f1b3281052c76c56b1a34c0dc9f06d4.png[/img]


[i]Alright, this is it!
[b]Focus for next time[/b] will be a good iteration over the classes and a big enemy update.
Since this update took longer but also had a lot more things than anticipated, we will likely try do a shorter update where we polish up the classes to a good state and then do the big enemy update, while doing a class progression update afterwards, not to forget multiplayer of course.

We'll likely do a roadmap update or another dev post in the near future.

Let us know what you think!
We hope you enjoy!

- Team FFG
[/i]

notes.title: Update 3 - BOOST PLUS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/230b5d3f288ee020ab4e50a509884b00e310558e.png[/img]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]
We know its only been 2 weeks since the last one but we've got another update before the Holidays!
As follow-up to the BOOSTER update, the BOOST PLUS update is continuing on the improvements around items and abilities but more of this work will need to be finalised in the near future.
Here is what is new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/7f68c8d1445e620de688f0eac80c35f40c3c72c9.png[/img]

[h3][b]ACTIVE POWER SLOTS![/b][/h3]
- NEW [b]Active Power Slots[/b]
- Items which have the trigger "[b]On class ability use[/b]" can now be toggled to use a [b]power slot[/b]
- In the Upgrade menu "U" you can click the power slot button to activate at no cost
- You have [b]2 potential power slots[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/c73dc9bab12fb11b418a8c12af10e3297453a59c.png[/img]

- This will allow [b]manually activating the item[/b] with a hotkey
- It also increases the Effect Power of the item, the first slot by 30%, the second slot by 15% 
- By default, your first 2 items will automatically have the power slots enabled

[quote=Shrike]Power slots are an ideal solution for all the issues with random active items, they allow you to have items on hotkeys but within a limited number, so you can never have 10 hotkeys at the same time, nor do you have to scramble with a fixed slot that is incompatible with other items. The power boost adds another layer of choice and could be extended to other items as well potentially. With this system, a player can also keep his items on reactive, or the amount of slots could be scaled up or down, or turned off by default (per example on Consoles) and the System shows even more potential for other upgrades. [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/9f40445873817afca7b2bc313f913354dd879957.png[/img]

[h3][b]CURSED ITEMS[/b][/h3]
- NEW Cursed Item Chest
- NEW Item - [b]Incubus[/b]
- NEW Item - [b]Core of daring[/b]
- NEW Item - [b]Bloodrite[/b]
- NEW Zir Shrine Event: [b]Feat of Strength[/b]
- NEW Zir Shrine Event: [b]Steal Relic[/b]

[quote=Shrike]You can now find cursed items in special chests, or from a new Zir shrine event, they generally offer increased rewards or power but at a difficulty cost[/quote]

- NEW Item - [b]Ghost Spawner[/b]
- NEW Item - [b]Twin Grenade[/b]

Some items have been tweaked or their activation changed in favor of power slots.
There is definitely more potential in the new system than is in use right now, we have some ideas
already how to make even more use of power slots in the near future.

[h3][b]ITEMS[/b][/h3]
- Item shops and rarity of items in shops have been increased for better choices
- Now with crazy item upgrades and power slots, we are also testing having a [b]cap of 6 items[/b]
- This allows making more impactful choices and loadouts and reduces information overload

[quote=Shrike]This may sound like a negative at first but we think this does improves the quality of the gameplay and people who tested the beta seem to agree. Right now the items do not feel a lot like a loadout with an idea or strategy behind, but more like a random assortment of things like you would see in a passive upgrade driven game. Reducing the amount lets you keep track of what is going on and plan an actual loadout and strategy. In Synthetik 1 we had 8 items, now we have 8 items and 3-4 abilities, with the change this be closer to S1 (10 vs 8). Same as with the map sizes, bigger did not turn out to be better.

With upgrades being a lot deeper now and the power slots, I think this is a good change towards more clarity and impactful choices, and stray away from "just collect things until full" - Shrike[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/f102d7cac2f14bf7dd8d293fd3b9f35dc24051e0.png[/img]

[h3][b]COMPOSITOR[/b][/h3]
- We are slowly phasing out or reworking the current compositor upgrades
- This is due to the current system not making much sense in the way it is used technically
- The cool ones will either stay or become perks for terminals you can obtain
- NEW - All [b]abilities now can use the same upgrades as the items[/b]
- Right now, the composites are staying as rare upgrades while more work is being done
- The idea is to have later rare composites based on [b]slot [/b]or [b]technology type of the item/ability[/b]

- Both item & ability upgrade types now go up incrementally in cost
- initially they should have a cap of 4 just like attachments, but we try this instead first
- We still want to allow rare 6-8 upgrade god-items, but at 600 cost it was clearly game-breaking
- Overall, the new upgrade system, while not fully complete yet, does show a lot of power already!

[h3][b]TERMINALS[/b][/h3]
- Varied [b]new [/b]terminal events
- [b]Reworked [/b]varied events to be more interesting
- 2 shops per map now appear more often
- Item and weapon shops offer more rare goods
- Weapon shops and gambling shrines are more rare
- Item shops more common

Overall terminals are starting to get in good shape and already offer a good amount of varied choices and formats now. Some icons also have been replaced.

[h3][b]RARITIES:[/b][/h3]
- Rarities had an issue fixed and now should behave as intended
- This means in some shops the epic and legendary things are now as rare as they should

The general rarity weighting looks/should look like this: 
50% - Common
30% - Uncommon
15% - Epic
5% - Legendary

In some loot/shops this was already the case more or less, but in some this will make a noticeable difference, so balancing is shaken up and we will gather feedback on this topic.
Weapon/Item shops notably drop higher rarity level loot however

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/5b5af43d1676a76678aeec1551164370ed1234a1.png[/img]

[h3][b]LEVEL IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
- Silo and Training got some[b] design changes[/b] and [b]improvements[/b].
- Some overly big and convoluted maps got more [b]compact[/b]
- Varied map improvements in terms of cover placement, collisions and spawn camping
- Still an ongoing process, post your gripes in the level-issues channel on discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/b982b4f3e7968d6a06cc22f072d536aabf4611cc.png[/img]

[quote=Shrike]We are trying to keep sizes more consistent throughout the game and reduce
on overly huge maps, as they do not make for great gameplay, have a lot of backtracking,
confusion and make the balancing of item/weapon drops very hard.
We will continue with some adjustments to the Oilrig and Mainboard levels[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/93ef0ff113177cbd5dde1e5952a2e64a5e972f66.png[/img]

- Enemies AI shoots less unneccessary on cover positions
- Arena Masters have more health
- Armored defender armor increased
- Bosses are now invulnerable in cutscenes
- Reduced Silo Jet Boss health by 15%
- Increased Sawblade Boss health by 15%
- K9s have a different attack sound
- Riotshield enemies have a much more generous backside attack area
- Enemy shotgunners damage reduced a bit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/5b5af43d1676a76678aeec1551164370ed1234a1.png[/img]

[h3][b]UNLOCKS:[/b][/h3]
- Each class now has one pistol costing only [b]75 Data[/b] (down from 150)
- Each class now has one spec costing[b] 2 unlock tokens,[/b]
- Exp requirement for level 5 [b]reduced [/b](15000>10000)

This makes you unlock some things fast in short playtime but doesn't let you unlock everything easily. Some new handguns are planned for the Armory update!

[h3][b]OTHER:[/b][/h3]
- Amount of upgrade parts grants increased when above 350 parts
- Precision Strike damage doubled
- Reduced Facemelter damage
- Chrono charge increased volume
- Unstable chrono charge deals more damage
- Varied specs had wrongly setup ability categories fixed
- Grenadier Multi Talent duration 1>1.5s
- Launchers now eject shells on reload
- Improved chat colors
- Changed Cheat menu to not cause a massive lag at the start, work in progress
- Orbital Authority and Power kick have improved shake
- Orbital Authority now deals more damage, executes targets if below 35%
- Buffed Riotguard Judge lifesteal
- Weapon swap no longer needs to complete the fire timer of the last shot
- Facemelter now dosn't trigger if an enemy is within 5m range
- Twice is the charm and double misfire now increase extra shot amount and work
- Updated class menu a bit to be more clean and use class colors
- Due to being super cursed, prismatic chain is being removed until reworked
- Spike strip now is stronger, lasts 90 seconds
- K9 item secret
- Varied UI improvements
- Varied unlisted changes which got forgot

[h3][b]FIXES:[/b][/h3]
- Tons of things that were reported have been fixed
- If you see any action or other related things which do not work as intended,
please report them in the discord channel for action bugs (or Steam if must) 
and they will be fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/83c04c66fe107ddc5b8b51b5098ce3cfbf80c6d3.png[/img]

[h3][b]SOUNDS[/b][/h3]
- Many feedback sounds and player weapon sounds are now in 2D instead of 3D
- This makes them have the proper volume they should and appear closer to you
- Varied sound improvements
- Known issue: Some sounds are overblown 

[h3][b]PERFORMANCE:[/b][/h3]
- Some smaller improvements, mostly for low settings
- Remember to update your drivers if you haven't - this may definitely help!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/0fffaf9f5185f3b1835cacabcf8806d9cf7be2ea.png[/img]

- NEW - [b]Merge Depot[/b]
- You can now merge depots you got from other people into your own
- This will also allow us to add mod content much easier to the game if wanted

- Weapon burst now works at 0
- Particles can now be scaled
- Added a couple more tooltips

[h3][b]ATTENTION MODDERS:[/b][/h3]
- IMPORTANT! Make sure your class abilities have the category "Action Archetype: [b]Any[/b]" category
If you want your abilities to use the orange upgrades. This means they can use any upgrade.
It is also recommended for all items or class abilities to have the new technology category set for the future. We always try to be as little disruptive to mods as possible but with adding new things this is not always possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/817f68645a73f8b2b85aabf1182dc930f6162db1.png[/img]

[h3][b]PRIORITIES:[/b][/h3]
The biggest priorities for the near future:
- Wrapping up the action system and making upgrades and scaling work fully in all regards
- The "Armory" Update with focus on everything all around weapons
- Improving map flow, variation and decreasing some sizes
- There are always the typical UI, UX, Bug, Performance, Sound 
and general improvements and [b]multiplayer [/b]of course.
Don't forget out roadmap on synthetikuniverse.com.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/2ca5fb68b8d05b6e030d391111d77f91c8fb8605.png[/img]

Here is a very rough overview of our current intentions.
Alright, that's it! We hope you enjoy and wish you merry holidays!

Have fun! - Team FFG

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/6eeb244a7eda2efc8dc07c277c39283e9670a1e8.png[/img]

Hey everyone!
The new update is live, this time with a good mix of changes and improvements all around. 
The core systems are getting close to completion, many of the update components now work but it still needs a little more. The next update "Armory" will focus all around weapons and still estimated this December if all goes well.


[h3][b]ENVIRONMENTS[/b][/h3]
- New levels for Power Plant (Electro floor), including biological laboratory
- New variations for rooms and spaces at existing levels
- Visual improvements for environment objects

[h3][b]ONGOING[/b][/h3]
- Improved cover in many areas for more cover gameplay
- Improved enemy enounter placements in varied areas
- Improved visibility in varied areas
- Fixed varied spawn-camping areas
[i]This is an ongoing process, remember to post 
us screenshots of areas which are sub-optimal![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/162da7b28f273a09a7cd6003c4648c6243f8888d.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/5b5af43d1676a76678aeec1551164370ed1234a1.png[/img]

[h3][b]GLOBAL CHAT[/b][/h3]
- The first iteration of the Global chat is live!
- Right now its only in the main menu, we will add it to the other places soon.
- The new global chat has an improved featureset like support for channels, 
commands and a better ban system but right now its only the start.

[h3][b]CHESTS[/b][/h3]
- NEW: [b]Varied Chests and chest effects[/b] 

[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3]
- NEW: Mayhem mode - Alternative gameplay modifier
- Fixed a big issue introduced last patch that caused random weakpoints and strange damage
- This affected both player and enemies
- Increased credits from recycling (300 up to 1200 based on rarity)
- Explosive (and other types) barrels system improved - be careful, they are really explosive now!
- Summons now spawn rotated in player direction
- Cursed chests now demand 75 kills, fixed curse granting better shield delay

[h3][b]INSTAKILL PROTECTION[/b][/h3]
- There is now a protection against cheap deaths, it triggers if dropping below 30% health
- This will be further refined over time. Let us know how this new one works out for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/7f68c8d1445e620de688f0eac80c35f40c3c72c9.png[/img]

A good chunk of items were added to spice up the pool. Loot should feel more varied now but of course more is to come

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/c0a7fa6c06ff7e506ef980a0b71057dd51ccf4f9.png[/img]

[h3]- New Item: [b]Brawndo[/b][/h3]
The classic Brawndo as you know it

[h3]- New Item: [b]Precision Strike[/b][/h3]
A Mortar on command

[h3]- New Item: [b]Mortar Barrage[/b][/h3]
Killstreak already?

[h3]- New Item: [b]Heat Sink[/b][/h3]
Fueling the flames

[h3]- New Item: [b]Heat Spreader[/b][/h3]
Powerful fire aura

[h3]- New Item: [b]Fire Prism[/b][/h3]
Another returning S1 item

[h3]- New Item: [b]Twin Link[/b][/h3]
Double the firepower

[h3]- New Item: [b]Shield Discombulator[/b][/h3]
Some more defensive options

[h3]- New Item: [b]Fusion Mines[/b][/h3]
Small and annoying

[h3]- New Item: [b]Stun Mines[/b][/h3]
We know your favourite items are mines

[h3]- New Item: [b]Spike Strip[/b][/h3]
A Police classic

[h3]- New Item: [b]PF42 Sticky Bomb[/b][/h3]
More Big Explosions

[h3]- New Item: [b]Dog Whistle[/b][/h3]
Time for a robo treat

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/35839b5de9e048f9e00ebf5b5c185cd39e9f7b13.gif[/img]



[h3][b]ICON UPDATE[/b][/h3]
- 150 Icons got a HD upgrade, from 100x100 to 256x256 size, greatly increasing quality
- Many new icons have been added in the editor, some are already in use within weapon perks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/7a811253d97885275c46e3e8b18103f679b24aca.png[/img]

[i]Many improvements are done under the hood to make the very deep new upgrade system work optimally but it will need one or two more patches to be perfectly rounded. Per example, before all class abilities use charges by default to make upgrades possible which grant charges, but this will not be necessary anymore. This patch however marks a huge step towards the completion and will enable the majority of desired features.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/f102d7cac2f14bf7dd8d293fd3b9f35dc24051e0.png[/img]

[h3][b]UPGRADE RELATED IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]
- Tooltips now [b]show Item/Ability upgrades[/b] after bought
- [b]Multi-Casting[/b] is now implemented
- [b]Double, Triple, Quad cast[/b] is now implemented
- [b]Damage effects[/b] now scale with effect power
- [b]Summons[/b] now scale with effect power

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/87d9f0318dce00f1fed2d391f52b69f4c3cf897c.png[/img]

- Item / Ability power now shows in the tooltip
- [b]Cooldown reduction[/b] now shows in the tooltip
- [b]Charges recharge time[/b] now shows in the tooltip
- Varied other improvements to action upgrade effects



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/fda2e6e3348d19ca15b9b5d6dee2586ddb7c1334.gif[/img]
[h3][b]PANDORAS BOX[/b][/h3]
- Total overhaul, now should work well, opening a ton of new possibilities!
- Most Effects now work and it can be used multiple times for crazy item combos.
- This should mark a big change towards the run progression of the game
- Some things do not fully work yet, most notably items which spawn things which spawn things
- More improvements coming soon, getting all these things working is a priority right now



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/fb22ce376a0ebc18d696a8ca3a97cd47d638a574.gif[/img]
[h3][b]COMPOSITOR[/b][/h3]
- First step in improving the compositor
- Pass on mobility upgrades
- Varied fixes, changes and improvements
- Class abilities now show their type (Class mobility, Core Ability, Utility Ability, Spec Ability)
- More work on improving the compositor upcoming

[h3][b]SHOPS[/b][/h3]
- New Tinkerer Terminal upgrade: [b]Power Printing[/b]
- Items rearrange themselves now after selling in the inventory bars
- Shops now properly update after selling
- Action Upgrade shops now technically allow multiple choices (item upgrade shop will later get it)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/93ef0ff113177cbd5dde1e5952a2e64a5e972f66.png[/img]

[h3][b]ENEMIES[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]- NEW: Propaganda Aura Turret
- NEW: Shock Mortar Turret
- NEW: Alarm Turret
- NEW: Weapon Locker Turret[/b][/h3]
[i]These are in testing, we are looking for your feedback[/i]

- Fixed the slow backwards rotating move some enemies did when attacked
- Fixed an behaviour where recruits were waiting for 2-4 seconds doing nothing and just staring
- A pass on AI, patrolling and movement is still upcoming
- Fixed an issue where everything had random weakpoints
- Fixed an issue from last update where enemy projectile speed was faster than it should
- Fixed an issue where enemies used a wrong attack range, we will have to re-tune some things
- Riotguards rear-size dead zone increased 130° > 200°
- Reduced tier 1 enemies in second floor
- Nerfed Arena sniper and last defender damage

- NEW: automated level cleaning system: 
- several tiny robo-cleaners now are keeping all floors clean after any kind of hard battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/c4b0ef2d22bec5da4737b17d5a2144665795ecb7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/f6220bb18cefdf44c79929037fbad5563a8b6974.png[/img]

[i]A Bigger pass all around weapons is planned for the next update[/i]

[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3]
- Until the december update rework, all weapons will now have 1 tech perk (up from 0-1)
- Tech perks are default unlocked right now, this will be changed then
- Increased damage amount required for perk unlocks
- Added missing tooltips to starter handgun perks
- Added notifier for upgrades

[h3][b]TWEAKS[/b][/h3]
- Patrol revolver damage 2.2 > 2, Recoil reset increment 15>20, Recoil reduced 20%
- Kago Tear gas works again
- Tokko Fusion recoil reduced
- Shock Lightning launcher AOE improved
- Industrial Breaching Cutter heat speed reduced
- X1000 Heavy rifle accuracy and ejection speed reduced
- P20 improved firing sound

[h3][b]ATTACHMENTS[/b][/h3]
- New Attachment: Ignition Core (idea by IGNITRO)
- Barebones allocator ammo regen 1 > 3
- Reworked Stock Pouch
- Fixed varied attachment issues

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/549dbfcfec5089604352b02d4541a06e05dbb25d.png[/img]

[h3][b]MENUS[/b][/h3]
- NEW: Reworked Class Menu
- NEW: Classes are now automatically created and no longer need a save slot creation process
- NEW: You can now also preview specs that you do not own
- The class menu now is much faster, requiring half or less than half the clicks to switch a class
- Note: Additional class slots had to be deleted, your first class slot is taken
- Keep in mind that this is work in progress and will be further improved
- Improved End screen, now shows additional weapon info such as attachments

[h3][b]HUD[/b][/h3]
- Improved ammo counter at character
- Now shows at <40% ammo and is larger, more visible flashing
- Removed tooltip popups from all Items

[h3][b] MOD BROWSER[/b][/h3]
- Downloaded mods are now default enabled
- Added filters to the Mod Browser
- Added Mod Description (Duh) to the Mod inspector

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/1f546ac68690fd2253a32f781f3235adbf06d50d.jpg[/img]

Big shout-out to all the great mods so far! What people have been making is very impressive.
Remember to try them out - Its just a couple clicks away, installs automatically, no work required!
You can join the modding discussions on Discord as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/14736e1efdb9f8dc0d218687bcdb13938bf01e91.png[/img]

There will be more class changes in the near future, but this should cover some of the biggest concerns and make some classes more fun

[h3][b]CHRONO TROOPER[/b][/h3]
- Chrono Trooper Chrono Charge Cooldown 18>17s
- Chrono Trooper Chrono Charge now has 2 charges
- Chrono Trooper Chrono Charge Damage from 700>600
- Chrono Trooper Danger overdrive now refreshes shields
- Chrono Trooper Prismatic Chain duration increased, now works properly
- Chrono breacher Breaching Charges reworked - at best just try it out
- Chrono breacher Defensive Focus now grants 1 breaching charge on plating loss
- Shield Dome now grants 500 max shields and might give shields to summons
- Chrono Striker will get a closer look soon
- Varied fixes

[h3][b]RECON[/b][/h3]
- Psy cloud grenade now also grants chance to not consume charges (given these are like cooldowns)
- Psyonic field now reduces firerate 10% per shot for 2 seconds, damage 150>125
- Psy Recon has a new focus perk
- Base Recon now has +25% shield regeneration
- Engine disabling shot now grants improved deviation for accurate shots
- Anti-Tank mine now holds 2 charges
- Varied fixes

[h3][b]GRENADIER[/b][/h3]
- Base Grenadier slight rework due to explosive run being unbalanceable
- Explosive Run now consumes a grenade charge to explode
- HE Grenade now has 1>2 charges
- Explosive Run now has 10>7s cooldown
[i]- This gives flexibility in grenade usage and you can have more mobility as damage is not tied to mobility cooldown, also the explosion could be made stronger. Let us know what you think, if people hate it we can revert the change, but it should be for the better[/i]

- Assault grenadier melee attack now has aoe targeting and effect
- Bundle grenade now also uses ground targeting for better control
- Fixed an issue where Reactive plating did not reduce max shield
(Reactive plating is not nerfed in terms of plating, we'll see how the shield reduction plays out)
- Varied fixes

[h3][b]RIOTGUARD[/b][/h3]
- Base Riotguard [b]Painkiller [/b]perk replaced with new perk: [b]Manstopper[/b]
- Tear gas grenade now uses ground cursor target for better control
- Judge life-steal reduced by 2.5%
- Judge Orbital Authority now deals + 200 damage
- Judge Orbital Authority now deals double elite damage
- Judge Elite kill rewards now show a feedback panel

[i]In general many non working perk elements have been fixed, but please let us know if you see something not working. Remember you can use [b]CTRL [/b]when viewing the tooltip to see some (but not all) details[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/0fffaf9f5185f3b1835cacabcf8806d9cf7be2ea.png[/img]

[i]UniversEdit improvements are technical upgrades for the framework and the game.
As we use the same UniversEdit as you (yours is much faster even), you will get all the same benefits[/i]

[h3][b]NEW EFFECTS[/b][/h3]
- Modify current action cooldown, this changes a running cooldown directly
- Set Charges Recharge Time To Cooldown Duration - used for charges upgrades, will see use soon

[h3][b]EMIT PARTICLE[/b][/h3]
- It is now possible to [b]emit particles[/b] from varied bone positions on the character
- This allows as example muzzle glowing effects, great for "next shot boost" and such effects

[h3][b]ICON UPDATE[/b][/h3]
- Foreground and background icons now use [b]one shared pool[/b]
- This granting [b]tons of new[/b] visual icon [b]design possibilities[/b] for actions 
- Many [b]new icons[/b] have been added, especially [b]Nano, Scatter, Fire, Ion, Curse[/b]
- [b][!!] Warning for Modders:[/b] Sadly we had to [b]reset [/b]the ActionIconBackgrounds 
(the backgrounds behind the transparent icons) but you will see that it was worth it when trying it out

[h3][b]WEAPON AUDIO[/b][/h3]
- You can now have 2 shot sounds and mix together their volumes and pitches
- Weapon shooting, Eject, Reload and Active reload now have pitch ranges
- Pitch now can go into negative to reverse a sound

[h3][b]CHEAT MENU[/b][/h3]
- The debug menu is there to test your mods
Edit: It was not intended to show all our content, so it will be temporarily disabled until its fixed, sorry!

[h3][b]ANIMATIONS[/b][/h3]
- New upper body animations which can be used for varied effects:
- Weapon Spin
- Weapon Slap
- Weapon Quick Reload
- Weapon Active Reload

[h3][b]NEW STATS[/b][/h3]
- Reload Speed Stat (yes we see the irony here)
- Ejection Speed Stat
- Armor Piercing Stat

[h3][b]0-1 to 0-100[/b][/h3]
- Most things like chances and percentages are now normalized to 0-100 range instead of 0-1 range
- Crit chance, dodge, no ammo cost, double shot, jamming, multi cast, health percentage etc
- Heat is not yet, but will be in the next days, tell us if you see something falling out of line

[h3][b]OTHER[/b][/h3]
- Added many more tooltips to Editor stats and similar
- Note: If you use cooldown reduction, you usually also should add charge recharge speed
- Increased size of text fields for better writing (having notpad++ nearby still recommended)
- Removed some non relevant inputs from results
- The 8-Ball action is now set up with a proper category, making it easy to add new 8-ball quote sets

[h3][b]SPAWN ENTITY[/b][/h3]
- Spawn Entity can now [b]filter by category[/b] (per example spawn a random Tier 2 Police enemy)
- Spawn Entity can now [b]spawn multiple at once[/b] (both ideal for wave spawning events)
- The same is enabled for [b]Spawn Action[/b]
- Spawn Entity now supports giving extra stat overrides to the entity, ideal for summons (+2000 hp..)

[h3][b]@MODDERS[/b][/h3]
- Mods will have to reapply their [b]ActionIconBackgrounds[/b] but you have way more choices now
- Remember to check your weapons if they have [b]ammo pickup[/b] not at 0 (@AnimeGirl)
- Remember most chances now use and will use 0-100, check out the new tooltips!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/83c04c66fe107ddc5b8b51b5098ce3cfbf80c6d3.png[/img]

[h3][b]MUSIC[/b][/h3]
- Added 1 new track to Police Academy level
- Added 1 new track to Missile Silo level
- Added 1 new track to Oilrig level

[h3][b]PERFORMANCE[/b][/h3]
- Further AI performance improvements
- Audio performance improvements
- General [b]CPU [/b]performance improvements

[h3][b]SETTINGS[/b][/h3]
- Gamepad settings now properly save on exit
- Added individual hotkeys for weapon slots
- Settings now show which GPU is active

[h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3]
- Changed many sounds to mono (as they should) - this reduces distortion on some
- Sound normalization is off, let us know if you think some sound has degraded so we can fix

[h3][b]FIXES[/b][/h3]
- Fixed a ton of issues, too many to list
- Many attachments, upgrades, items, class actions ... now work as they should
- Please report us any effect you notice not working, remember you can check some things with [i]CTRL[/i]

[h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/h3]
- Varied impact sounds are missing
- Attachments are missing their background images
- Alarm Drones don't trigger
- Multicast, Action critical etc Sounds are wrong
- Upgrades have no limits right now and can go too crazy
- Health-regeneration has an issue
- ?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/6207e18fca43138977d932041f66c711b9f27a4f.png[/img]

[b]Upcoming:[/b]
[i]It was planned that the Dec 14 was supposed to be the Weapon patch (and active item power slots), but since this one got a lot bigger than anticipated we have to see if we want to do it for the next week with more limited scope or have it around new year after the Christmas weeks, we'll keep you updated![/i]

Pretty solid changes for the first month we would say ; )
As you can see, we are dedicated bring Synthetik 2 into its best form. 
A bunch more work is to be done, but this Update already marks a big step towards that goal.

We will do a small fix patch ASAP tomorrow or so if needed.
We hope you enjoy! - Team FFG

notes.title: Update 1 - INTEL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/32e46d20088bd1174a00ed28644ae9bc4b8c7b6c.png[/img]


Hey everyone!
The new update "INTEL" is now live!
We worked hard on many many improvements based on your feedback.
In general we are very confident about our future plan and certain about what needs to
be added, changed and improved, so worry not!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/5b5af43d1676a76678aeec1551164370ed1234a1.png[/img]

[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]
- Further increased movement speed
- Most maps have spawn points adjusted to remove boring or dragged out areas/gameplay 
- Some new map variations and visibility improvements have been added
- Loot has further been tweaked

[i]This is an [b]ongoing process[/b], keep telling us how you feel on these topics 
and point out the weaker areas so we can improve them![/i]

[h3][b]MECHANICS[/b][/h3]
- Ejecting the magazine now grants a 10% speed bonus for 1 second for extra smoothness
- Ejecting the magazine now increases cooling by 50% as long as the magazine is out
- Varied [b]grenades [/b]have been changed to a much more convenient [b]cursor target[/b]

[h3][b]KNOCKBACK[/b][/h3]
- We added a knockback mechanic which now works on enemies from varied effects
- Keep in mind that this will be only for singleplayer due to technical reasons

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/14736e1efdb9f8dc0d218687bcdb13938bf01e91.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/6108da83f2aef21dc718b9989ac4351acaee6217.jpg[/img]



[h3][b]CLASSES[/b][/h3]
3 new Specialisations have been added.
The Recon is essentially the new Sniper class and offers 3 fully fledged different specialisations.
You should also not look him directly in the eyes.

[h3][b]NEW - Recon [/b][/h3]
[i]High damage Marksman with focus on weakpoint hits, accuracy and positioning[/i]

- Evade
- Flash Grenade
- Weakpoint Scan
- L24 'Eraser'
--Channel Power
--Deflection System

[h3][b]NEW - Recon Psyonic[/b][/h3]
[i]Utility focussed infiltrator with psyonic effects and item affinity[/i]

- Dodge Roll
- Engine Breaking Shot
- Weakpoint Scan
- Anti-Vehicle mine
--Psy Infused shots
--Hacker

[h3][b]NEW - Anti-Material Recon[/b][/h3]
[i]Slow but hard hitting vehicle hunting sniper[/i]

- Dodge Roll
- Engine Breaking Shot
- Weakpoint Scan
- Anti-Vehicle mine
--Defensive Measures
--Vehicle Hunter


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/93ef0ff113177cbd5dde1e5952a2e64a5e972f66.png[/img]

[h3][b]ENEMIES[/b][/h3]
- Last Defender is now in the game
- Varied fixes in AI
- Increased enemy type pool per map by 1
- Increased tower amount per map by 1
- Suicide Pineapple Drones now have a delay and sound before exploding
- Reworked taser bot to shoot a weapon and have a targeting indicator (Wip)
- Melee Enforcer now has an 1s ion shield, is generally slower, no more plating
- Enemy riotguard can now shield bash when in melee range, removing shields
- More improvements coming
- New - Some missiles can be shot down (missile dronem Jet Boss)
- Fixed random faction reroll after each map, now happens in third floor

[h3][b]DIFFICULTY[/b][/h3]
- [b]NEW [/b]- Lightning Start difficulty modifier
- [b]NEW [/b]- Tactical difficulty modifier
- Higher difficulty and terrorlevel is now harder
- Run and gun and relaxed no longer reduce exp gain
- Run and gun now has a deviation malus
- Removed slow effect from lightning traps
- Homing missiles and mortars are slightly harder
- Flinch now has a 1 second cooldown (0.5s duration)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/549dbfcfec5089604352b02d4541a06e05dbb25d.png[/img]

[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
- Weapon stats now all update and show armor pen and damage
- (Damage is based on point blank damage right now)
- Added ammo counter to player when below 25% ammo
- Added ammo display on ammo pickup
- Added [b]EXP bar[/b] ingame which shows exp gained after combat ends
- Added sound for levelup

[h3][b]MENU[/b][/h3]
- Starting with some menu improvements but ongoing
- Added quickplay button to the end screen
- Added quickplay button to the class menu
- Removed multiple layers on the end screen
- Added scroll bar to difficulty modifiers

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/7f68c8d1445e620de688f0eac80c35f40c3c72c9.png[/img]

[h3][b]ITEMS[/b][/h3]
- New Item: Helsing Power Bolt
- DMR Sentry turret now spawns on Utility ability
- Varied small tweaks
- A solution for more active items is coming in the next 1-2 patches

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/f6220bb18cefdf44c79929037fbad5563a8b6974.png[/img]

[h3][b]WEAPONS[/b][/h3]
- New Attachment: [b]Hair trigge[/b]r (Switches to semi auto)
- Weapons now properly gain their own ammo pickup values
This means that ammo economy has changed significantly, 
Let us know how you feel about certain weapons
- Fixed pistols requiring much less upgrade parts than other starters
- Many attachments have been fixed

[h3]NEW Uncommon Special weapon - [b]Heavy Flak Cannon[/b][/h3]
[h3]NEW Epic Marksman rifle - [b]R2000H Anti-Material[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]HEAT[/b][/h3]
- Added [i]rudimentary[/i] first version of ]always visible heatbar
- Many weapons have increased heat, but there might have been some non optimal tweaks
- Let us know which ones you want to see changed
- Added Heat sound when reaching higher heat levels on shooting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/83c04c66fe107ddc5b8b51b5098ce3cfbf80c6d3.png[/img]

[h3][b]OTHER CLASS[/b][/h3]
- Chrono TP reduced blur effect
- Chrono Breaching charges reach 2m further
- As mentioned, Chrono Striker, Trooper, Grenadier, Assault Grenadier speed slightly increased

[h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3]
- Removed 2 tracks in training level which had Content ID enabled
- Added one temporary track back, replacement is coming
- Main menu and combat / idle tracks now should be shuffled randomly
- Changed the weaker of the two headshot sounds to be more powerful (WIP)
- Reduced music volume slightly in comparison with sounds

[h3][b]FIXES[/b][/h3]
- Fixed tons of actions that did not work fully (Shrines, Attachments, Perks etc)
- Let us know if you see any things that still do not have their effects

[h3][b]PERFORMANCE[/b][/h3]
- Noticeably Improved single core performance 
- Varied improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/0fffaf9f5185f3b1835cacabcf8806d9cf7be2ea.png[/img]

[h3][b]UNIVERSEDIT / MODDING[/b][/h3]
- Downloaded depots/mods are directly enabled
- [b]New [/b]Effects: Switch to Semi / Burst / Full Auto
- [b]New [/b]Conditions: Check for multiple entities in range
- [b]New [/b]Conditions: Check for Current ammo
- [b]New [/b]Conditions: Check for Totalammo
- [b]New [/b]Conditions: Check for Backpack ammo
- Added varied weapon targeting indicators which can be used for enemies
- You can now see if a collection has something inside (targets etc)
- You can now delete an depot
- Improvements to delete self action
- Varied fixes
- Added 18 Synthetik 1 weapon images for modding

Modders join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/RVUqxWtZDN]Discord [/url]if you want help with your things or talk with others about modding!

We also have to note here that we are very impressed with the things people have created so far with the [i]UniversEditor [/i]. There are some impressive classes already or great other mods like Caramel's difficulty modifiers or Egg's Tech Perks pack.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/h3]
- Chrono riotshields have an strange stun?
- Some new perks do not work (Eraser, Defensive measures)
- Keybindings sometimes do not save?
- Enemy bullet speed is faster than it should
- If you made a modded weapon, due to ammo pickup fix, the ammo pickup is reset 
to 0 and needs fixing

[i]Keep in mind that this is Early access and we can not do this level of huge amounts of changes and have the same amount of polish each patch as a fully released game with far less output and months long wait cycles, so some things will break or become worse than before. These things will usually be fixed shortly. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305564/25602da714b25f383742eef432b881ba1a6dfb56.png[/img]

Here again big thanks to everyone supporting us within the early access!

Rest assured that we know about the current gripes with the game and are working on improvements in all areas. Day 1 and Update 1 'INTEL' already marks many significant improvements and many more things will follow! 

The roadmap is coming +- on monday, stay tuned.
Team FFG
